MRI Information
The Sable SCS System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 and 3 Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- a maximum spatial field gradient of 3 T/m.
- Maximum gradient slew rate of 200 T/m/s per axis.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Any receive-only coil may be used.
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- maximum B1+rms of 2.8 uT; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg.
3 T scanning conditions:
- B1+rms <= 1.2 microtesla; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1 W/kg.
- Limit total active scanning to 30 min.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: MRI SureScan mode.
The image artifact extends approximately 3 mm from the device.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
